description.text: 6 weeks of Intensive Chinese language summer courses are offered for international students at all proficiency levels of the Chinese langauge, beginner, elementary, intermediate, good, and advanced, from all over the world. Small classes, native Chinese student language partners, experienced teachers. Duration: July 8th to August 16th (6 weeks) Tuition Fee: * Tuition Fee for the Regular Classes: 1-week: RMB 820 2-weeks: RMB1230 3-weeks: RMB 1640 4-weeks: RMB 2050 5-weeks: RMB 2460 6-weeks: RMB 2870 4 class hours a day in the morning (45 minutes each), five days a week. Please notice that the number of students of each regular class is at least 6 of about the same level of the Chinese language. If the number of students of the same level of Chinese language is less than 6, they should take the mini-classes. * Tuition Fee for the Mini-classes: 1 (student) on 1 (teacher) class; RMB80 (about $11) /per class hour; 2 on 1 class; RMB70 (about $10) /per class hour/per student; 3 on 1 class; RMB50 (about $7) /per class hour/per student; 4 on 1 class; RMB40 (about $5.7) /per class hour/per student; 5 on 1 class; RMB35 (about $5) /per class hour/per student. (2-4 hours a day at the students’ own choice, 5 days a week; 1 class hour = 45 minutes. For 2/3/4/5 on 1 class, students should be of about the same level of the Chinese language.) Textbooks: about RMB 100 (about $15) Accommodation Fee: Twin Room – Standard Type (at Hui Xian Yuan): Twin Room (Type A) Fee RMB28 (about $4) /per day / per bed Pay by lump sum for 4 months or more (i.e. pay for 4 months or more at a time) RMB33 (about $4.7) /per day / per bed Pay monthly RMB40 (about $5.8) per day / per bed Pay for less than a month Twin Room (Type B) RMB30 (about $4.3) /per day / per bed Pay by lump sum for 4 months or more (i.e. pay for 4 months or more at a time) RMB35 (about $5) /per day / per bed Pay monthly RMB42 (about $6) /per day / per bed Pay for less than a month Indoor Facilities Internet access, Telephone, Cold / warm water, Satellite TV system, Bedding, Air conditioner, Central heating, Toilet with shower, Free washing machine and kitchen on each floor Twin Room – Hotel Type (at International Exchange Center): RMB50(about $7.2) / per day / per bed Pay by lump sum for 1 month or more (i.e. pay for 1 month or more at a time) RMB60 (about $8.6) / per day / per bed Pay for less than a month Indoor Facilities Free Internet connection, Telephone, Cold / warm water, Satellite TV system, Bedding, Air conditioner, Central heating, Toilet with shower

duration.text: The Summer Course at Tianjin University of Technology is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 398 USD/In total ￥ 2870 CNY/In total

materials.text: Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: Graduation from high school (or the equivalent), 18 to 60 years of age.
